title: Head fullness or congestion during adaptation
non_drug_steps: Record when the fullness is most noticeable and any associated symptoms.
Use the official onboard fluid-shift observation and comfort procedure.
Recheck the symptom and record the change at the next check-in.
escalate_if: Symptoms are severe, rapidly worsening, or affect vision, breathing, or safe task performance.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not medical advice.

title: Sleep disruption
non_drug_steps: Log sleep and wake times, interruptions, and contributing environment factors.
Use the mission-approved sleep routine and protect the scheduled sleep opportunity.
Reassess sleep at the next daily check-in.
escalate_if: Sleep loss persists or impairs alertness, judgment, or mission duties.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not medical advice.

title: Musculoskeletal or bone-protection trend
non_drug_steps: Review exercise completion and equipment availability in the mission log.
Follow the assigned exercise and bone-protection plan; do not make unapproved changes.
Track discomfort, function, and exercise minutes at the next check-in.
escalate_if: New pain, weakness, injury, or reduced ability to perform assigned tasks.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not medical advice.

title: Blood pressure or heart-rate drift
non_drug_steps: Pause strenuous activity and repeat the measurement using the approved measurement procedure.
Record the reading, time, symptoms, and measurement conditions.
Contact ground / follow the emergency procedure when escalation criteria are met.
escalate_if: Red alert, repeated abnormal readings, chest discomfort, fainting, shortness of breath, or new rhythm symptoms.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not medical advice.

title: Behavioral or cognitive decline
non_drug_steps: Record the change and any sleep, workload, or isolation factors.
Use the mission-approved peer-support and behavioral-health check-in.
Contact ground / follow the emergency procedure if safety is at risk.
escalate_if: Decline persists, affects judgment or crew safety, or includes thoughts of self-harm.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not medical advice.

title: Radiation dose threshold
non_drug_steps: Confirm dosimeter and exposure records using the mission procedure.
Review mission radiation-monitoring guidance and the current shelter instruction.
Log the dose and follow the crew radiation-response checklist.
escalate_if: Mission threshold is crossed, dosimeter data are inconsistent, or a solar-particle event is announced.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not medical advice.

title: General urgent health escalation
non_drug_steps: Contact ground / follow the emergency procedure.
Share the flagged measurement, symptoms, and recent trend with the crew medical officer or ground team.
escalate_if: Any red alert or rapidly worsening symptom.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not medical advice.
